svg.title: Where antibody deficiencies block B-cell development
svg.desc: B-cell development from the bone marrow to antibody secretion, marked where inherited defects stop it: BTK and the parts of the pre-B-cell receptor (IGHM, IGLL1, CD79A, CD79B, BLNK) at the pre-B cell, causing agammaglobulinaemia; CD40LG and CD40 at T-cell help, and AICDA and UNG at class switching, causing hyper-IgM syndromes; and NFKB1, NFKB2, CD19 and TNFRSF13B at the step to plasma cells and memory B cells, as in common variable immunodeficiency.
